name: QualitySetting
doc: Rendering quality. auto picks from the GPU: High on ray-tracing GPUs (Medium below 8 GiB of video memory), Low without ray tracing. Epic is never automatic.

variants.name: low
variants.doc: Raster renderer with temporal antialiasing; no ray tracing.

variants.name: medium
variants.doc: Raster lighting with ambient occlusion and screen-space reflections.

variants.name: high
variants.doc: Raster lighting with stronger shadow, GI and screen-space effect budgets.

variants.name: epic
variants.doc: The highest raster shadow, GI and reflection budgets. The most expensive.
